stories.title: Snow-White and Rose-Red
stories.description: Two sisters who share everything welcome a gentle bear into their winter home, then discover that their new friend is hiding a magical secret.
stories.catalogueBlurb: Two kind sisters, a friendly bear and a secret hidden in the forest.
stories.author: Brothers Grimm, retold by Quill
stories.coverAlt: Otto Ubbelohde's 1909 illustration for Snow-White and Rose-Red.

stories.title: The Duck Bread Baker
stories.description: Join Duck on his delicious journey as he sets out to satisfy his love for bread. But when all his feathered friends fall ill, he learns that a diet of just bread isn’t the way to go.
stories.catalogueBlurb: Duck learns why loving bread still means eating a balanced diet.
stories.author: David Fairbairn
stories.coverAlt: The Duck Bread Baker cover, showing a yellow duck surrounded by loaves of bread.

stories.title: The Elves and the Shoemaker
stories.description: A kind shoemaker receives mysterious help at night, then finds a way to thank the tiny visitors who changed his fortunes.
stories.catalogueBlurb: A grateful shoemaker discovers who has been helping him each night.
stories.author: Brothers Grimm, retold by Quill
stories.coverAlt: Historic illustration of the elves helping the shoemaker.

stories.title: The Hare and the Tortoise
stories.description: A speedy hare is certain he cannot lose, until a quiet tortoise shows what steady determination can do.
stories.catalogueBlurb: A boastful hare learns that steady determination can win the race.
stories.author: Aesop, told anew by Joseph Jacobs
stories.coverAlt: Richard Heighway's 1894 illustration for The Hare and the Tortoise.

stories.title: The Lantern at the Edge of the Woods
stories.description: A young unicorn follows an unlit lantern into the dusk and discovers why some paths only brighten when they are shared.
stories.catalogueBlurb: A young unicorn follows a mysterious lantern into the dusk with a friend.
stories.author: Quill

stories.title: The Lion and the Mouse
stories.description: A tiny promise seems impossible until a trapped lion discovers that help can come in every size.
stories.catalogueBlurb: A tiny mouse proves that even the smallest friend can make a big difference.
stories.author: Aesop, retold by Quill

stories.title: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse
stories.description: A country mouse visits his sophisticated cousin in town and discovers that luxury is not much fun when dinner comes with danger.
stories.catalogueBlurb: Two cousins discover that a peaceful meal can beat a grand feast.
stories.author: Aesop, told anew by Joseph Jacobs
stories.coverAlt: Richard Heighway's illustration for The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse.

stories.title: The Twelve Dancing Princesses
stories.description: Every morning twelve princesses wake with their dancing shoes worn through. A curious traveller follows them through a hidden staircase into a glittering midnight world.
stories.catalogueBlurb: Twelve worn-out pairs of shoes hide a glittering midnight secret.
stories.author: Brothers Grimm, retold by Quill
stories.coverAlt: Arthur Rackham's illustration for The Twelve Dancing Princesses.
